	la = ppar.Labelalign	
	
	scop.clear()

	scop.appendRow( ['path', 'parameter', 'value', 'enable'] )

	else :

		ih = bh
		
	lw = 0 if la=='none' else ( (bw - iw) if (la in ['left', 'right', 'center']) else bw )

	scop.appendRow( ['label', 'alignx', ppar.Labelalign, '1'] )

	scop.appendRow( ['text', 'x', oitx * bw, '1'] )

	fontsize = 12 if parent().par.Fontauto==True else parent().par.Fontsize

Go to https://neutone.space/plugin/, install the VST3 for your operating system.  Make the path in audiovst point to the plugin.

and from the VST UI panel. download the demucs stem separation.

It only outputs stereo, so we feed it 2 monos, and bring down to mono after.

The expression in audiovst's p1 parameter should be   parent().par.Nutonebass, etc

Most effective is to make Drums = 1 and the rest at 0.  Listen to audiodev1 to hear what it's filtering out.

It occasionally falls way behind so you need to make Active off then on again, or a similar action.

The Neutone authors should be made awre of these imperfect behaviors.

def cook(scrop):

	parentw = parent().width
	parenth = parent().height
	
	if (ppar.Horizvert == 'horizontal') or ((ppar.Horizvert == 'auto') and (parentw >= parenth)) :
